patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Mom) He's had a cold and a fever, then his arms and legs shook for about a minute and his eyes rolled back. It stopped on its own. He's sleepy but waking up now. It was TERRIFYING.
clinical.presentationShort: 2yo M — brief (~1 min) generalized febrile seizure, now postictal but rousable; URI symptoms, NO rash, NO neck stiffness, fontanelle closed.
clinical.presentationLong: 2-year-old male, brief generalized seizure with fever during a viral URI, self-terminated in about a minute, now postictal but rousable, with no rash and no meningismus.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → antipyretics, identify the fever source, parental education; discharge if simple and back to baseline.
diagnosis.why: Simple febrile seizure: brief, generalized, single, back to baseline, NO meningismus → benign. The scary look isn't high acuity. (Meningitis is the one to exclude.)

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 2-year-old boy, flushed with fever, in pajamas
aiImageGeneration.pose: drowsy on the clinic chair, leaning back
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 2-year-old boy in pajamas, flushed with fever, seated leaning back on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: drowsy, leaning back, limp and sleepy. Expression: dazed and sleepy, a postictal look. Clearly visible: flushed cheeks and heavy, drowsy eyes. No text, no logos.
